description: Run one of the seven reference pipelines on the pricing-chain engine without a key: every number in the answer is computed. Rate limited per IP (10 per hour). Answers 501 pipeline_execution_unavailable while the public-pipeline-run flag is off. Needs context.current_price or context.unit_cost. Any stage it could not run is listed under not_run, and the rest still prices. Works without a Last Price credential; list_pricing_pipelines shows the pipelines.

context.description: The numbers to price from. Needs current_price or unit_cost.

image_consent.description: true confirms the product image may be sent to a third-party model, for the pipelines that read images.

pipeline.description: Which reference pipeline to run. Defaults to fast_path.

name: run_reference_pipeline
